name: markdown_mermaid
description: Markdown and Mermaid is a text-first scientific documentation output primitive. Use it for research documents, READMEs, architecture notes, workflow diagrams, and version-controlled deliverables where editable Markdown and accessible Mermaid should remain the source of truth.
capabilities: Represent scientific workflows, architectures, schemas, timelines, and relationships as Markdown with Mermaid diagrams.
Keep diagrams diffable, editable, and renderable without a binary source of truth.
Apply document templates, heading, citation, and diagram accessibility conventions.
requirements: Markdown renderer with Mermaid support when diagrams must be previewed.
A document type and intended audience.
